flows.title: Send a message
steps: Open the channel, DM or thread to send the message to.
From the Messages tab, click the message field.
Type the message, adding any attachments, emoji, mentions or formatting.
Press Enter to send it. To send it later instead, click the arrow next to the paper plane icon.

flows.title: Create a channel
steps: Click the plus sign in the sidebar.
Select Channel. On a paid plan, select Blank channel for a regular channel, or choose a template.
Enter a channel name, choose whether it is public or private, then click Create.

flows.title: Search messages
steps: Click the search field at the top of Slack.
Type what to look for, or select a recent search. Add modifiers to narrow the results.
Select an option from the list, or press Enter to view all results. Click Filters to refine them.
